page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t5-c1m4.large is a burstable virtual instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, delivering 2 vCPUs powered by a single physical core with Hyper-Threading. The architecture is x86_64, supporting AVX-512 foundation instructions, AES encryption acceleration, and FMA capabilities. System memory is configured at 8.0 GB of RAM, allocating 4.0 GB per vCPU. The instance comes with no bundled local storage, zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and a 0 Gbps baseline network bandwidth allocation.

Benchmark testing places the ecs.t5-c1m4.large primarily in the lower 10th percentile across synthetic CPU, memory, and application workloads. The CPU achieved a PassMark score of 2229.6 and a multi-core Geekbench score of 1493. Memory throughput measures at 16.3 GB/sec for uncached read operations and 14.44 GB/sec for uncached write operations. In application tests, it delivers 2.54 million Redis SET operations per second and 1.48 GB/sec static web serving throughput. The burstable CPU allocation model restricts continuous heavy compute, resulting in reduced performance for multi-threaded or persistent processor-bound tasks.

Due to its burstable compute limits and entry-level hardware profile, this instance offers a cost-conscious entry point for low-intensity workloads. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio provides adequate memory capacity for lightweight background processes, basic web hosting, low-traffic microservices, and development environments that experience intermittent CPU activity rather than constant processing demands.
